Home Description

The Stanley II is a winning combination of comfort and adaptability. The main floor offers a bedroom with a full bath for guests. Of course, no one could blame you if you crafted an exceptional workout room instead. A wall of windows in the airy living room illuminates the space with natural light that carries into the casual dining area and the spectacular kitchen. Quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances and a gorgeous island ensure the kitchen will be everyone's favorite space. The presence of an upstairs loft near the bedrooms with a full bath creates a home-within-a-home!

Discover Cibolo Hills West

Discover Cibolo Hills West, a new home community in northwest Fort Worth that offers the perfect balance of peaceful suburban charm and urban accessibility. Located just off Business 287, Cibolo Hills West provides a quick and easy commute to downtown Fort Worth, putting work, entertainment, and culture within reach. You’re also just minutes from Alliance Town Center, a bustling destination for shopping, dining, and weekend fun. For outdoor enthusiasts, Eagle Mountain Lake is nearby, offering scenic beauty and endless opportunities for boating, fishing, and lakeside recreation. Inside the community, residents enjoy a variety of amenities designed to enhance everyday life. Take a dip in the resort-style pool, let the kids play at the community playground, or enjoy a peaceful walk through beautifully landscaped green spaces. And for pet owners, the dog park provides a safe and welcoming space for four-legged family members to run, play, and socialize. Families will love the convenience of being part of the highly regarded Eagle Mountain-Saginaw ISD, with two on-site schools already serving the community and one additional school planned for the future - making school routines easier and keeping education close to home. Cibolo Hills West isn’t just a place to live, it’s a place to grow, connect, and thrive. Come explore the possibilities and experience the best of Fort Worth living in a community built for today and tomorrow.
